As you progress into mid game, the major pieces you are on the hunt for are your Uniques. Remember : 100% attack speed and 100% crit strike should be your primary focus then worry about your multipliers.

Welcome to the Minion Necromancer Endgame Guide.  With items such as

, you can increase the amount of summons that you can command.  No matter which variant you choose, you will have a solid frontline and and incredible gameplay experience..  Whether it be hordes, pits, or casual bossing, this build can manage all endgame content incredibly well.  So if you like the idea of commanding an undead army or just like having a lot of friends (even if you have to resurrect them from the dead), this is the place for you!  In this guide you will find two unique variants of this build "Mages" and "Singularity."  Mages are your overall go to variant with the ability to conquer t12 and all bosses while Singularity, is your powerhouse for pushing pit and tower.

Overall this build is an incredible addition to the Necromancer builds.  Finally able to truly command the undead army while unleashing tons of damage.  Your minions will tank for you  and as long as you watch out for the ground effects, you can expect to progress quickly and efficiently.
